name: kiwicaptcha/kiwicaptcha-php
description: KiwiCaptcha: privacy-first, self-hosted proof-of-work anti-abuse engine for PHP. Zero third-party services or tracking; optional first-party telemetry; PHP-native verification (the optional RSW time-lock algorithm uses GMP).

suggest.ext-gmp: Required only for the optional RSW time-lock algorithm
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Required for the SQLite challenge storage adapter (SqliteStorage), the zero-infrastructure single-node backend
suggest.ext-openssl: Optional: the core hashes and HMACs use ext-sodium/ext-hash primitives; install only if other parts of your stack need it
suggest.psr/cache: Required for the PSR-6 challenge storage adapter (Psr6Storage)
suggest.psr/log: Optional structured logging of verify outcomes
suggest.bel-consulting/kiwicaptcha-symfony: Symfony bundle integration (form type, validator constraint, Twig widget, challenge endpoint)
